discovery_provenance.discovery_role: post-result exploratory candidate generation only; none of those seeds may enter this holdout

scientific_question: Does the continuous reserve of the strongest remaining local refuge at the start of generation 10 discriminate realised all-patch high-trait loss by generation 40 in a fresh full-feedback ensemble, and does the full eco-genetic route margin add predictive ranking beyond the co-timed strongest local interaction state?

forcing.observation_state: snapshot at generation 9, immediately before the generation-10 q update

primary_score.name: continuous_last_refuge_route_margin
primary_score.risk_direction: lower max_j M_j means higher risk
primary_score.timing: all q, N, T and G inputs come from snapshot generation 9; no generation-10 or later state is used

predeclared_comparators.co_timed_max_q: max_j q_j at snapshot generation 9; lower means higher risk
predeclared_comparators.co_timed_mean_q: mean_j q_j at snapshot generation 9; lower means higher risk
predeclared_comparators.co_timed_mean_population: mean_j N_j at snapshot generation 9; lower means higher risk
predeclared_comparators.co_timed_H_alpha: H_alpha at snapshot generation 9; lower means higher risk
predeclared_comparators.co_timed_H_gamma: H_gamma at snapshot generation 9; lower means higher risk

replication.paired_seed_mapping: AA and RR use the same trajectory seed within every master-seed/replicate key
replication.seed_exclusion: No master seed used in PR 162, PR 160, PR 154, PR 153, PR 152 or their precursor edge-decomposition ensembles may be reused.

primary_estimands.discrimination: For each master seed, compute threshold-free ROC AUC for -max_route_margin versus g40 loss on the pooled AA+RR full denominator. Report the mean of 12 seed-block AUCs and a two-sided t-based 95% CI across the 12 block AUCs.
primary_estimands.incremental_information: Within each master seed, compute AUC(max-route-margin risk) minus AUC(co-timed-max-q risk). Report the mean paired difference and two-sided t-based 95% CI across 12 master seeds.
primary_estimands.timeliness: Among all trajectories that lose by g40, report the fraction whose loss has already occurred by generation 9.

decision_rules.candidate_confirmed_as_early_discriminat: The lower 95% CI bound of the 12-block mean AUC for max route margin is strictly above 0.75 AND the fraction of eventual g40 losses already occurred by generation 9 is below 0.05.
decision_rules.route_margin_adds_ranking_beyond_q: The lower 95% CI bound of the paired seed-block AUC difference (route-margin minus co-timed max-q) is strictly above 0.
decision_rules.q_only_explanation_retained: If the route-margin AUC is confirmed but the paired AUC difference versus co-timed max-q includes zero, conclude that strongest-local-q is sufficient for ranking in this holdout and retain route margin only as mechanistic interpretation.
decision_rules.candidate_not_confirmed: If the max-route-margin AUC lower CI is <=0.75 or the timeliness fraction is >=0.05, do not promote it as an early discriminator.

stop_rules: No new observation time, score transformation, threshold, endpoint, assignment, feedback weight, seed, barrier schedule or comparator may be added after the first holdout outcome file exists.
No threshold is selected for max route margin or any comparator; discrimination is threshold-free ROC AUC.
Do not redefine the observation state from snapshot generation 9 to a post-generation-10 state after outcomes.
Do not replace the co-timed max-q comparator with next-q or any post-observation variable.
Natural systems remain Discussion-level projections and are not validation data for this finite holdout.
claim_ceiling: A successful holdout establishes predictive discrimination only within the declared finite full-feedback closure. It does not establish a universal natural warning variable, a causal natural threshold, or portability across taxa and landscapes.
